# 06 — Identify test gaps

## Objective
Prioritise meaningful missing test scenarios based on behaviour and risk.
## Required context and areas
Use recovered requirements, risk register, current tests, source, and `reference-outcomes` only when facilitator permits.
## Change constraints
Analysis only; do not generate or change tests.
## Response format
Gap ID, requirement/risk, missing scenario, priority rationale, recommended test level, candidate case, assumptions.
## Assumptions
Separate risk estimate from facts and ask SMEs about uncertain expected outcomes.
## Validation and evidence
Check existing tests before declaring a gap; record commands run and save the gap matrix/evidence.
